goal: 成功办理银行开户及相关事务

n1.speaker: 银行职员 Clerk Wang
n1.line: Good morning, sir. How may I assist you? Please speak up so that I can deal with your request quickly.
n1.lineCn: 早上好,先生。有什么可以帮您?请讲清楚,我好尽快处理您的事务。

grammar.name: 短语动词 deal with
grammar.note: deal with 意为"处理、应付",是商务与日常场合最常见的短语动词之一。

options.text: I would like to open a savings account. Could you walk me through the process?
options.textCn: 我想开一个储蓄账户。您能带我走一遍流程吗?

options.text: I need to sort out a problem with my credit card statement.
options.textCn: 我需要解决信用卡账单上的问题。

options.text: I am not sure what I need. I just came to look around.
options.textCn: 我不确定需要什么,只是进来看看。
options.feedback: 需求不明,职员帮你梳理。

n2.speaker: 银行职员 Clerk Wang
n2.line: Certainly. To open an account, you must fill in this application form and hand over your ID.
n2.lineCn: 当然可以。开户需要填写这份申请表,并上交您的身份证件。

grammar.name: 短语动词 fill in / hand over
grammar.note: fill in 填(表),hand over 递交、交出,两者都是办理手续的常用搭配。

options.text: I have filled in the form. Here is my ID and a copy of my passport.
options.textCn: 我已填好表格。这是我的身份证和护照复印件。

options.text: I will fill in the form, but I left my ID at home. Can I come back tomorrow?
options.textCn: 我会填表,但身份证落在家里了。我明天再来行吗?
options.feedback: 材料不全,职员建议改期。

options.text: Do I really need to hand over my original ID? I have only brought a photo.
options.textCn: 真的必须交原件吗?我只带了照片。
options.feedback: 材料不符,职员说明规定。

n3.speaker: 银行职员 Clerk Wang
n3.line: Let me look into that for you. Could you point out which items on the statement look wrong?
n3.lineCn: 让我为您查一下。您能指出账单上哪些项目有问题吗?

grammar.name: 短语动词 look into / point out
grammar.note: look into 调查、研究,point out 指出,组合使用使服务表达更专业。

options.text: There are two charges I did not recognise. Could you check them out for me?
options.textCn: 有两笔我认不出的扣款。您能帮我查一下吗?

options.text: I am not sure. Perhaps you can figure out what happened by yourself.
options.textCn: 我不确定。也许您自己就能弄清发生了什么。
options.feedback: 信息模糊,职员继续查证。

options.text: Forget it. I will give up on the refund and just put up with the charges.
options.textCn: 算了。我不追退款了,就忍下这些扣款吧。
options.feedback: 放弃维权,职员劝你重视。

n4.speaker: 银行职员 Clerk Wang
n4.line: I see. Before you go, let me work out what you actually need: an account, a card, or something else?
n4.lineCn: 明白了。在您离开前,让我理清您真正需要什么:账户、卡片,还是别的?

grammar.name: 短语动词 work out
grammar.note: work out 此处意为"理清、弄明白",也可表"算出、制定",是高频短语动词。

options.text: After thinking it over, I have come to the conclusion that I need both an account and a debit card.
options.textCn: 想清楚之后,我的结论是我既需要账户也需要借记卡。
options.feedback: 需求明确,转入开户流程。

options.text: I came across a notice about a new deposit plan. I want to look into that.
options.textCn: 我偶然看到新存款计划的公告,想了解一下。
options.feedback: 转咨询新业务,服务继续。

options.text: Nothing, thanks. I will drop by another day.
options.textCn: 不需要了,谢谢。改天再来。

n5.speaker: 银行职员 Clerk Wang
n5.line: Everything checks out. Now, to keep your account safe, please come up with a strong password.
n5.lineCn: 材料都没问题。为保证账户安全,请设置一个强密码。

grammar.name: 短语动词 check out / come up with
grammar.note: check out 核对无误;come up with 想出、提出,服务场景常用搭配。

options.text: I have come up with one, and I will write it down somewhere safe.
options.textCn: 我想好了一个,并会把它记在安全的地方。
options.feedback: 安全意识良好,继续办理。

options.text: I always go with my birthday. It is easier to remember.
options.textCn: 我一直用生日,比较好记。
options.feedback: 密码太弱,职员给出提醒。

options.text: Passwords are troublesome. Can we just skip that part?
options.textCn: 密码太麻烦,能跳过这步吗?
options.feedback: 想省事,职员说明必要性。

n5b.speaker: 银行职员 Clerk Wang
n5b.line: Excellent. For your security, please set up a withdrawal limit for your card.
n5b.lineCn: 很好。为了您的安全,请为您的卡设置取款限额。

grammar.name: 短语动词 set up
grammar.note: set up 此处意为"设置、设定",也常表"建立、安装",用法灵活。

options.text: I have set a daily limit of two thousand yuan. That should keep my money safe.
options.textCn: 我设了每天两千元的限额,这样资金更安全。

options.text: Set up a limit? I would rather have unlimited access to my own money.
options.textCn: 设限额?我更想随意取用自己的钱。

options.text: I will leave the limit to you. I trust your judgement.
options.textCn: 限额您来定,我信任您的判断。
options.feedback: 过度放权,职员按规矩办。

n6.speaker: 银行职员 Clerk Wang
n6.line: I have looked through your transaction history and picked out the two suspicious payments.
n6.lineCn: 我已查阅您的交易记录,并挑出了两笔可疑的付款。

grammar.name: 短语动词 look through / pick out
grammar.note: look through 浏览、查阅;pick out 挑出、辨认出,组合用于查询场景。

options.text: That rings a bell. I might have subscribed to a service and then forgotten about it.
options.textCn: 有点印象。我可能订阅了某项服务然后忘了。

options.text: Those payments are nothing to do with me. Someone must have taken over my account.
options.textCn: 那些付款与我无关,一定是有人侵入了我的账户。

options.text: I do not care how they got there. Just put through a refund immediately.
options.textCn: 我不在乎它们怎么来的,立刻给我退款。
options.feedback: 急躁无理,职员按流程办。

n6b.speaker: 银行职员 Clerk Wang
n6b.line: I have looked into the merchant and found that it is a legitimate subscription service.
n6b.lineCn: 我已调查过这家商户,发现它是正规的订阅服务商。

grammar.name: 短语动词 look into(调查)
grammar.note: look into 表"调查、深入研究",与名词 merchant 搭配,体现查询的严谨。

options.text: Then please go ahead and cancel that subscription for me.
options.textCn: 那就请替我取消那个订阅。

options.text: Keep the subscription, but put through a refund for the double charge.
options.textCn: 订阅留着,但请把重复扣款退回来。

options.text: I do not trust your research. I will complain to your manager.
options.textCn: 我不信你们的调查,我要向你经理投诉。

n7.speaker: 银行职员 Clerk Wang
n7.line: Almost done. Please go over the details one last time before we hand over your new card.
n7.lineCn: 快办好了。请最后核对一遍细节,然后我们交付您的新卡。

grammar.name: 短语动词 go over / hand over
grammar.note: go over 仔细核对、复习;hand over 交付、移交,服务收尾常用。

options.text: Everything looks correct. I am looking forward to receiving my card.
options.textCn: 一切无误。我期待收到我的卡。

options.text: Wait, my address has changed. Please set it right before you issue the card.
options.textCn: 等等,我的地址变了。发卡前请更正。

options.text: I trust you completely. There is no need to go over anything.
options.textCn: 我完全信任您,不用再核对了。

n7b.speaker: 银行职员 Clerk Wang
n7b.line: Wonderful. The card will be delivered within three working days. Please sign for it when it turns up.
n7b.lineCn: 太好了。卡片将在三个工作日内送达。卡片到时请签收。

grammar.name: 短语动词 turn up / sign for
grammar.note: turn up 出现、到达;sign for 签收,用于物流与投递场景。

options.text: I will sign for it as soon as it turns up. Thank you for the clear explanation.
options.textCn: 卡片一到我就签收。谢谢您讲解得这么清楚。
options.feedback: 沟通顺畅,服务完成在即。

options.text: I move around a lot. Could you hold on to the card until I come by to collect it?
options.textCn: 我经常搬家。您能先保管卡,等我上门自取吗?
options.feedback: 协调取卡方式,安排妥当。

options.text: Three days is too long. Can you speed things up?
options.textCn: 三天太久了,能加快吗?
options.feedback: 催促时限,职员说明规则。

n8.speaker: 银行职员 Clerk Wang
n8.line: I am afraid skipping procedures is not possible. Please bear with me while we carry out the checks.
n8.lineCn: 恐怕流程无法省略。请耐心等待我们完成核查。

grammar.name: 短语动词 bear with / carry out
grammar.note: bear with 容忍、耐心等待;carry out 执行、实施,礼貌服务的经典表达。

options.text: My apologies. I did not mean to hold things up. Please carry on.
options.textCn: 抱歉,我不是有意拖延。请继续吧。

options.text: I find these procedures too long-winded. I will just give up.
options.textCn: 这些流程太冗长,我不办了。

options.text: All right, carry on with the checks, but please hurry up.
options.textCn: 行,继续核查吧,但请快一点。

n9.speaker: 银行职员 Clerk Wang
n9.line: Your account is now active. Please look out for the confirmation message within ten minutes.
n9.lineCn: 您的账户现已开通。十分钟内请留意确认短信。

grammar.name: 短语动词 look out for
grammar.note: look out for 留意、注意查看,提醒客户关注后续信息。

options.text: I have just received the message. Thank you for seeing me through the whole process.
options.textCn: 我刚收到短信。谢谢您陪我走完全部流程。
options.feedback: 事务圆满完成,客户满意。

options.text: I will check for it. Could you also set up online banking for me?
options.textCn: 我会留意短信。您还能帮我开通网上银行吗?

options.text: I have changed my mind about the account. Please cancel it now.
options.textCn: 我改变主意不要账户了,请立刻注销。

n9b.speaker: 银行职员 Clerk Wang
n9b.line: Of course. Online banking takes just a few minutes to activate. Please come up with a separate password.
n9b.lineCn: 当然可以。网上银行几分钟即可开通。请另外设置一个密码。

grammar.name: 短语动词 come up with(设置)
grammar.note: come up with 此处表"想出、设定",与密码搭配,体现操作引导。

options.text: Done. I have set up my online banking and received the confirmation.
options.textCn: 搞定。我已开通网上银行并收到确认。

options.text: I keep mixing up passwords. Please figure out a way to merge them.
options.textCn: 我总记混密码。请想个办法把它们合并。
options.feedback: 职员说明安全原则,回到流程。

options.text: Actually, skip online banking. I will just use the mobile app later.
options.textCn: 算了,不办网银了。以后用手机应用就行。

success.speaker: 银行职员 Clerk Wang
success.line: You are all set. Do not hesitate to turn to us whenever you need further assistance.
success.lineCn: 您都办妥了。今后有任何需要,随时来找我们。

fail1.speaker: 银行职员 Clerk Wang
fail1.line: I am sorry we could not help. Should you change your mind, please come back anytime.
fail1.lineCn: 很遗憾没能帮到您。如果您改变主意,随时欢迎再来。

fail2.speaker: 银行职员 Clerk Wang
fail2.line: As you wish. Cancelling an account you just opened is unusual, but we will proceed.
fail2.lineCn: 如您所愿。刚开户就注销确实少见,但我们会照办。
